_comment: Copy to appsettings.local.json (gitignored) for a local run against real Azure
resources. Nothing here is a secret: SQL is Entra-only and Cosmos has local auth
disabled, so DefaultAzureCredential uses whoever ran `az login`.
The SQL server's standing firewall rule only admits Azure services, so add a rule for
your own IP before running - see README, 'Operating it'.
An Anthropic key, if you use one, belongs in user secrets rather than a file:
